info.title: PlaneMem persisted Plane observation reads
info.description: Source-only four-GET contract. Load this file, proposal-reads/context-history OpenAPI and the independent observed-read schema locally with paths/IDs preserved. These endpoints observe stored projections, not live upstream Plane facts, local work-item records or saved ContextPacks. No generated/tool/runtime/release evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure actual origin/base path.

x-runtime-boundaries.authorization: All four require Bearer and authorized tenant/workspace/project. context.read Policy/OPA and entry decision audit precede handlers; configured OPA replaces local Policy. No independent verified-client gate: authenticated-context fallback client can read. Expected actor/client headers are independently optional exact preconditions. Actual data.restricted.read, not admin alone, permits restricted SQL rows and configured memory recall. No post-read/recall session-expiry or visibility recheck.
x-runtime-boundaries.http: GET bodies/framing, media/encoding, Idempotency-Key, version/range/cache conditions are not specifically rejected. These observed routes are outside the generic readPreconditions block, so If-Match/If-Match-Version are not parsed or applied. No conditional206/304/412 behavior, ETag or outer revision/cursor. All four bypass in-process idempotent response caching, but still use the generic actor/path rate limiter. Application successes return private,no-store and current x-trace-id.
x-runtime-boundaries.budgets: No dedicated complete-success byte limit, two-slot gate or whole-operation deadline. Directory count1..100; memory adapter return at most1000 entries is validated before selecting19, with snippet65536 UTF-16 units and64 sources per memory hit. Snapshot fields/source arrays have no dedicated complete-response budget here. Provider-specific request timeouts do not establish an end-to-end HTTP deadline or cancellation.
x-runtime-boundaries.state-storage: One SQL statement joins saved projection, source event, same-version index and visible nondeleted parent. Event scope/type/aggregate version/payload/time must match; active index must be nondeleted/unexpired, deletion requires matching deletion event/time/index and does not require unexpired index. Restrict both parent/index classification unless actual restricted-read capability. No matching join yields404; two matching external/aggregate aliases yield500 ambiguity. Normalize selected snapshot with shared parser, without loading a full canonical-event envelope. State returns index classification; directory separately computes parent/index maximum.
x-runtime-boundaries.context-memory: Context first reads saved active state, then may recall configured memory using its display title. It does not hold one database snapshot through recall and never creates/saves a ContextPack. Optional provider absence, denial, failure or malformed whole batch yields local-only degraded200; required provider absence/failure/denial yields error. All memory content treated restricted, unique page_ref first occurrence retained, provider order kept. Full context is assembled without shared context parsing; SDK applies that parser and exact outer trace/source comparisons. Memory source extensions can survive HTTP and are removed by SDK normalization.

get.summary: Read the current project's saved Plane observation
get.description: No URL query fields. Decode path ID once and require trimmed valid record ID; it must equal authorized project_id, otherwise404. Read source ProjectCreated/ProjectUpdated joined to saved projection/index/current parent. Return active inner schema_version1 with original event ID, Plane version/time, public source references and saved fields. It is not a live Plane request or proof of latest upstream version. No synthetic fallback when joins/visibility fail and no memory recall.

get.summary: Read a saved active, deleted or restored work-item observation
get.description: No query fields. Path may be external Plane ID or canonical source aggregate ID, within current project; local work-item IDs are not universal aliases. Inner schema_version1 represents active state, including optional restored_from only for current WorkItemRestored source event. Restoration reference must equal fields.restored_from, name a different event ID and preceding plane_version-1; restored fields include external ID/nonblank title/status. Inner schema_version2 is deletion: fields only external_id, deleted_at=observed_at, no status or restoration marker. Outer envelope remains1. Expired index may still expose matching deletion metadata, never its old title/content. Deleted/invisible parent or inconsistent/missing join404; ambiguity or malformed selected snapshot500. Later ordinary updates may retain arbitrary fields.restored_from but do not acquire a top-level restore marker.

get.summary: Build a transient context summary from saved work-item state and optional memory
get.description: No query fields. Same state read first; visible deletion produces410 before memory recall. Local title uses nonblank saved fields.title else external_id, sliced to1000 UTF-16 units; query equals this title. First synthesized hit has plane:WorkItem:external_id, same version/classification/sources, score1 and rank_source=fts; this is not a fresh FTS search. Append at most19 unique memory hits, each title ai-memory, rank_source memory, classification restricted and score1/(memory index+1). Validate the entire at-most1000 provider batch for scope, ID, snippet, safe revision and source bounds before deduplication/selection. Aggregated sources deduplicate by type/id, first full source retained; source version/URI/extension differences do not replace the first. backend=postgres, vector_used=false. memory_used=true may have zero external hits; absent optional provider still makes outer degraded=true. Required memory needs actual restricted-read capability even for admin. No full shared context parser at server output: pathological whitespace-prefix titles can be emitted then rejected by SDK's stricter nonblank query/title checks. This result neither saves a ContextPack nor changes the projection or upstream record.

get.summary: Page current saved observation metadata without payload or memory recall
get.description: One SQL statement requires visible nondeleted parent and event/projection/index coherence, then filters state and ASCII-insensitive literal substring over external/aggregate ID and active display title. Unlike state read, directory explicitly checks source event schema_version1 and identity/status payload consistency in SQL; failed joins/conditions are omitted. Title/status are SQL LEFT2000/255 Unicode scalars, deleted metadata retains neither. Classification is maximum of parent and index with unknown values conservatively restricted. Sort external_id COLLATE C ascending, limit+1; normalize/validate first limit and build continuation from last returned ID. Lookahead contributes existence only and its metadata is not separately parsed. Missing/hidden parent404, visible empty directory200. checked_at is statement timestamp; no cross-page snapshot, total, has_more, source body or history. v2 cursor binds exact scope, actor/client (including fallback), restricted flag, trimmed query preserving case, state and limit; changed case invalidates key despite equivalent matching. It is neither signed nor an authorization token, and incoming base64url encoding is not roundtrip-canonicalized.
get.x-http-query: Only query/state/limit/cursor, each once. limit requires1..3 ASCII digits without leading zero then1..100. Query raw<=500 UTF-16, no controls/DEL/lone surrogates, trimmed; blank becomes empty. Empty state/cursor invalid. Defaults query empty/state active/limit25.

ProjectPathId.name: project_id
ProjectPathId.description: Decoded ID must exactly equal current authorized project.

WorkItemId.name: work_item_id
WorkItemId.description: Decoded external Plane or source aggregate ID in the authorized project.

ProjectSuccess.description: Complete project observation; outer sources exactly match normalized data sources. No ETag or live Plane fetch.

WorkItemSuccess.description: Complete active/deleted/restored observation. Deleted inner schema2 still uses outer schema1 and returns200; outer sources equal normalized snapshot sources.

ContextSuccess.description: Saved active work_item and transient context_pack search summary. Outer sources equal summary's deduplicated sources; optional recall failure can yield degraded local-only success. No saved pack ID/hash/TTL/ETag.

DirectorySuccess.description: Current metadata page with empty outer source_refs, scope and SQL checked_at, optional explicit next_cursor. No total/has_more/history or payload copies.

Error.description: Application error; transport/proxy failures can use another representation. No automatic retries or partial usable state.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for malformed encoding/record ID, query on single-record routes, unsupported/repeated/bad directory filters or mismatched/invalid continuation. retryable=false. No generic version-header parse error is introduced on these four routes.

BadContext.description: INVALID_INPUT as state route; required recall MEMORY_SCOPE_MISMATCH for malformed/cross-scope batch, or MEMORY_MCP_EMPTY_RESULT/MEMORY_MCP_INVALID_RESULT from configured provider currently map400. retryable=false for these explicit codes. Optional recall failures instead degrade to local-only200.

Denied.description: DENIED for scope/expected-identity/Policy denial or required memory without actual restricted-read capability; retryable=false. Admin does not replace restricted-read. Hidden SQL records/parent use404.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND for different project path ID, missing/invisible parent or state, expired active index, or absent/inconsistent event/projection/index join. Directory hidden/missing parent404; visible parent with no eligible rows200. retryable=false.

Deleted.description: OBSERVED_RECORD_DELETED when context read observes valid visible deletion; retryable=false. Stops before memory recall. Explicit state read can return the deletion marker, but no automatic fallback is performed.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED by generic actor/path limiter; retryable=true. No dedicated observed-read concurrency limit or Retry-After promise.

InvalidStored.description: OBSERVED_STATE_INVALID for ambiguous state identity or malformed selected snapshot/directory metadata; retryable=false. Invalid scope discovered during output parsing can also map here. Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR defaults retryable=true.

InvalidContext.description: OBSERVED_STATE_INVALID as state route; required recall MEMORY_RESULT_INVALID for invalid source references, retryable=false. Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR defaults retryable=true; optional recall failure is degraded200.

Unavailable.description: OBSERVED_STATE_UNAVAILABLE for missing database or SQL read failure; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. retryable=true. No in-memory substitute observation.

ContextUnavailable.description: Same storage/auth/audit503 plus required recall: MEMORY_PROVIDER_OFF retryable=false; non-ContractError MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE retryable=true; MEMORY_MCP_ERROR/TOOL_ERROR retryable=false; MEMORY_MCP_UNAVAILABLE retains provider retryability (HTTP>=500 or request failure true, other non-OK HTTP false). No common retryability is inferred from503. Optional recall failures degrade to local-only200.
